resolution: Fixed the supported-wall intersection overhang shown in the screenshots. The old join extender assumed perpendicular walls were centered and extended by half-depth; with one-sided floor support that pushed a wall past the second intersection face. Join limits now use the perpendicular wall's actual placed.depthSpan in world space, preserving unsupported centered-wall notch closure while stopping floor-supported walls at the real face. Added REQ-0472 coverage. Verified build-placed 46/46, build-snap 18/18, and full hmsc-int esbuild bundle.
